VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 118 tests pass and describes the technical fix (switching from sliding window on calendar minute to true rolling window), there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test results, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports cannot establish objective verification of test passage or code correctness in a production fraud rules engine context.
